topic: claude code blocks cloning other games; neelville is original
hook: Claude just banned one kind of game. And developers are furious.
caption:
Claude Code's new rule: it won't copy other people's games anymore. Comment ISLAND to claim your lot in mine 🏝

Anthropic added the rule around Oct 30, and developers lit up Reddit and GitHub about it. Original games still work, so I made one: Neelville, an island where every follower gets a house, built by tiny robots. Day 3 is coming.

#claudecode #claudeai #aitools #gamedev #indiedev
